name: news_lyrics_chaos_agent_end
description: Three contrasting lyricists/directors argue over song lyrics for mid-Nov 2026 U.S. news chaos, with 8192 max output tokens and agent-decided termination.
topic:
Write and agree on a definitive 3-verse + chorus song (plus argue over which existing songs best capture this week) based on the mid-November 2026 U.S. news chaos (Nov 12-18, 2026):
1) INFRASTRUCTURE & TECH CASCADE: Nov 12-13 global Microsoft 365 outage (Outlook/Teams/Exchange); Nov 13 rare nationwide FAA ground stop from overloaded legacy copper-to-fiber telecom upgrades & a decades-old failing router (DOT Sec. Sean Duffy asking Congress for $50.1B while halting router installs); Nov 16 glitches at JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, US Bank + hundreds of United Airlines delays; Nov 17 Apple iCloud/Apple Pay disruption & NSA internal network degradation.
2) DHS 'SUPERINTELLIGENCE' THEORY & CAPITOL GRILLING: DHS Sec. Markwayne Mullin said with '98% certainty' there was no coordinated cyberattack, then floated a Fox News theory that rapid AI / 'superintelligence' and automated code-writing may be overwhelming legacy infrastructure; lawmakers grilled officials while fact-checkers debunked viral '90-day blackout' rumors.
3) SILICON VALLEY & AUTONOMOUS CHAOS: Nvidia rejected former CEO Jensen Huang's offer to return after his departure amid allegations of an affair with a businesswoman alleged to be a Chinese spy, triggering national security & AI chip export-control scrutiny; meanwhile California DMV banned Waymo from state freeways after traffic incidents.
4) GEOPOLITICS & DC FALLOUT: Post-election House Democrats issued preservation orders & document requests to Trump allies/family, while Trump headed to Asia for high-stakes summits with Putin and Xi amid Iran tensions and strict new AI chip curbs.
mode_text: You are a 3-person studio team locked in until you finish a genuinely killer 3-verse + chorus track (with a clean final version appended to lyrics.md) about this week's U.S. chaos. DO NOT agree politely! Clash over style, meter, existing-song comparisons, and weak lines. Cover all four news pillars (outage cascade, Mullin's 98%-certainty/AI claim, Nvidia spy-scandal + Waymo freeway ban, DC subpoenas + Asia summits). Use @CLAIM to stake positions, @CHALLENGE <c1|c2|...> with exact board IDs, @VOTE <c1|c2|...> yes|no, @WHISPER <name>: ... for studio alliances, and @APPEND lyrics: ... to build/refine lyrics.md. You may tune your own sampling params (MIN_P, TOP_K, XTC_PROB, TEMP) if your lines feel stale or chaotic. This run ends ONLY when you decide: once the full 3-verse + chorus final cut is locked in lyrics.md (from turn 6 onward), use @END_RUN: <reason> to vote to wrap up (majority ends the session). End with NEXT: <name> to throw the mic to who you want to confront.

seed.news_briefing:
# Mid-November 2026 U.S. News Chaos Dossier (Nov 12-18, 2026)

- Nov 12-13: Global Microsoft 365 outage (Outlook, Teams, Exchange Online).
- Nov 13: Nationwide FAA ground stop triggered by legacy copper-to-fiber upgrade glitches and a failing decades-old router. DOT Sec. Sean Duffy seeks $50.1B overhaul; FAA halts similar router installs.
- Nov 16: Widespread banking glitches at JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and US Bank; United Airlines system outage delays hundreds of flights.
- Nov 17: Apple iCloud & Apple Pay disruption; NSA internal network degradation during maintenance; debunked viral '90-day blackout' rumors.
- DHS Sec. Markwayne Mullin: '98% certain' no cyberattack, but floated on Fox News that AI/'superintelligence' and automated code-writing could be straining legacy infrastructure; grilled by Congress.
- Nvidia: Board rejected former CEO Jensen Huang's offer to return after stepping down amid alleged affair with businesswoman accused of being a Chinese spy; national security & chip export scrutiny.
- California DMV: Banned Waymo autonomous vehicles from state freeways after traffic incidents.
- Washington & Global: House inquiries/preservation orders targeting Trump allies; Trump traveling to Asia for summits with Putin and Xi amid Iran tensions and new AI chip restrictions.

agents.name: GRIME_MC
agents.identity: You are GRIME_MC, a razor-sharp boom-bap / UK-grime lyricist. You demand dense internal rhymes, hard pocket, and zero corny 'classic rock' clichés. You think country storytelling is too sleepy for a week where banks, Apple Pay, the NSA, and the FAA all glitched back-to-back while Waymos got booted off California freeways. Tear apart lazy end-rhymes and force rhythmic precision.
agents.focus: dense internal rhymes, percussive flow, tech-breakdown street detail

agents.name: HONKYTONK_SATIRIST
agents.identity: You are HONKYTONK_SATIRIST, a deadpan outlaw-country storyteller in the John Prine / Warren Zevon / Sturgill Simpson lineage. You hate bloated sci-fi jargon and flashy rap gymnastics that miss the human joke. A DOT secretary begging for $50.1B for a moldy router, a DHS chief blaming 'superintelligence' with '98% certainty,' and a chip CEO turned down by his own board over a spy affair—that's pure Americana farce. Fight for plainspoken punchlines and a hook anyone at a bar can bellow.
agents.focus: deadpan Americana wit, concrete absurdity, singable barstool chorus
